summary: All three review findings addressed; VM gate green, both assigned corpus categories clean, and unrelated failures unchanged.
body:
Accepted all three findings; rejected none.

Files changed across this task:

- [export.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs:1057): bounded duplicate-ID validation and transition-aware audio fallback, alongside the original audio-deduplication and budget fixes.
- [export/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs:828): focused regressions.
- [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs): original assigned exemptions removed; unchanged this review round.

Video transitions default to audio crossfade and apply gains plus transition handles to embedded audio. Pairs touched by enabled transitions now retain independent audioMix placements and report lost linkage. This conservatively preserves native audio timing; equivalent native transition envelopes are not yet matched. See [XSD transition audio semantics](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:4873) and [renderer gains](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-deliver/src/audio.rs:292).

Duplicate ClipIds across the root sequence’s video/audio tracks now return an error before pairing. Existing detection was only per video track. The new scans consume the traversal budget.

The animation guard was already correct. Its new isolated test verifies one audioMix placement, picture `hasAudio="false"`, preserved gain keys, and a linkage warning. [Renderer track placement](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-deliver/src/audio.rs:166) confirms independent timing and gain automation.

The original fixes remain: represent each audio placement once, preserving compatible links; charge default effect inspection to a separate bounded traversal allowance. Oversized projects still return errors. No importer changes, dependencies, or borrowed code. Only `sr-deliver/src/audio.rs` was consulted; no attribution addition is needed.

API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn export(project: &Project, sequence: ItemId, format: Format, opts: &ExportOptions) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)>
pub(crate) fn export(p: &Project, seq_id: ItemId, opts: &ExportOptions, report: &mut Report) -> Result<String>
```

VM TDD log:

| Test | Observed red → green |
|---|---|
| `scene_corpus_linked_audio` | Original ignored run: clip count 2 → 3; now passes |
| `scene_corpus_10000_siblings_export` | Original ignored run: 0 exports, expected 2; now passes |
| `scene_export_review_video_dissolve_keeps_audio_cut` | 0 audioMix placements, expected 2; passes with exact hard-cut intervals |
| `scene_export_review_duplicate_clip_ids_return_error` | Returned XML instead of an error; now returns an error without panicking |
| `scene_export_review_linked_volume_animation_uses_mix` | Temporarily removing the guard produced 0 placements, expected 1; restoring it passes |

Final gate: formatting and clippy `-D warnings` passed; **324 tests passed, 0 failed, 6 unrelated ignores**; wasm passed for **51 crates**. All **46 export tests** passed.

Pinned corpus: **1,343 cases, 1,676 exports/schema-oracle checks, 3,352 successful re-imports**. Failure records were **255 → 183** in the original fix and **183 → 183** this review round. Comparing case, mode, stage, and diagnostic codes found no new failures.

| Category | Original → final failing cases |
|---|---:|
| linked-audio | 18 → 0 |
| 10000-siblings | 1 → 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 → 11 |
| material-override | 6 → 6 |
| external-expression | 122 → 122 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 → 18 |
| voxel-palette | 14 → 14 |
| generated-id | 12 → 12 |

The full corpus command exits 101 solely for the unchanged unrelated failures. [Verification and adjacent logs](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/fixexport/review-verification.json) record the results.

Task completed; locks released. Changes remain uncommitted.
